decisions.reason: A low-cost accessory with negligible holding cost and a dedicated page, so keeping this cheap option open while demand information accumulates is sensible.
A home-page box trailer line that fits the core business, with one year of evidence too little to resolve uncertainty, so the option stays open.
Car transporters serve a professional niche with uncertain but plausible demand, and a separate page plus shared production keep holding costs low.
A low-bed series featured on the home page is a core trailer category with modest marginal cost, so the firm keeps it while results come in.
High covers are accessory variants that leverage existing trailers cheaply, so keeping them preserves upside at little cost.
A second box trailer series overlaps with B, which raises some consolidation risk, but it is still too early for the evidence to justify abandoning it.
